name: @qf-jarvis/api
description: QF Jarvis API application boundary. QFJ-S2-D-B (ADR-0064) made this the process boundary that acquires the production Groq model-inference credential from a mounted file. QFJ-S2-E-B (ADR-0065) adds two internal one-shot executables: a deterministic offline SHADOW evidence generator, and a controlled SHADOW runner that composes the existing gateway with a process-local rollout controller, resolves one credential, builds two Groq providers, transitions OFF->SHADOW->OFF, discards every model output, and enforces a hard call budget. Reusable packages receive configuration explicitly and read no environment; only an executable process boundary acquires deployment configuration. This application reads no process.env, exports nothing from its package root, and activates nothing by itself.
